description: Example roadmap for a fictional neighborhood bakery. Not a real shop. Copy this file to start your own. Build: python3 엔진/궤적만들기.py 예시/example-en.json

header.title: Regulars pre-order bread from their phones
lede: A fictional bakery, Wheatfield, wants to take orders from regulars by phone.
The owner's plan runs in order; extra requests from the owner are kept on their own line.
A sample for people trying the roadmap tool for the first time.
header.footer: Example data · not a real shop

nodes.title: Regulars pre-order bread by phone
nodes.summary: Regulars **order bread ahead** from their phones. The owner packs orders in advance. It opens from one link, no app.

nodes.title: Picked the 6 breads to take orders for
nodes.summary: We take orders for **only the 6 best sellers**. Chosen from 12 using last month's sales.
notes: The 6 made up 72% of a month's sales.

nodes.title: Made the first order page draft
nodes.summary: Built a page to **pick breads and a pickup time**. Three regulars ordered in 40 seconds on average.
notes: Pickup time is chosen in 30-minute slots.

nodes.label: Request
nodes.title: Added birthday cake orders
nodes.summary: At the owner's request, **cake orders were added**. Cakes must be ordered three days ahead.

nodes.label: Request
nodes.title: Cake dates are picked on a calendar
nodes.summary: Cake dates are now **picked on a calendar**. Mondays, the closing day, cannot be picked.

nodes.label: Cleanup
nodes.title: Gathered menu photos in one folder
nodes.summary: Scattered menu photos are now **in one folder**. One photo per bread, 6 in all.

nodes.label: Cleanup
nodes.title: Moved the price list into one sheet
nodes.summary: The wall price list moved **into one spreadsheet**. The page reads prices only from it.
notes: Found the salt bread price differed by 30 cents.

nodes.title: Send order alerts to the owner's phone
nodes.summary: Order alerts **go to the owner's phone**. 9 of 10 test alerts arrived within a minute. Looking into the one that was late.
notes: Alerts go by messenger, so they cost nothing per order.

nodes.title: Choose a payment service for prepaying
nodes.summary: **Pick a payment service** for paying ahead. Compare two and take the lower fee.

nodes.title: Ten regulars try it for a week
nodes.summary: Ten regulars **try it for a week first**. Find the rough spots before opening to everyone.
